This looks age-restricted

Your request mentions —, which is commonly an age-restricted item. To keep everyone compliant with legal and safe-guarding protocols, please confirm whether this is an age-restricted request before continuing.

Submitting an age-restricted request without a valid ID at completion means the worker cannot release the items. The order may be canceled, you may still be charged worker time/fees, and repeat issues can lead to account review.
⚠️

Most age-restricted orders need a purchase

You marked this age-restricted but turned off Purchase needed. Almost all age-restricted deliveries require a purchase — without one, your card is authorized for a lower amount, and if your Gopher needs to add items later, re-authorizing your card can fail and stall your order.

Only skip if you truly don't need anything purchased — e.g. a prescription pickup or pre-paid alcohol.

A quick note on your offer

You're always free to offer whatever you'd like, neighbor — but this one's on the lower end of what Gopher iQ suggests.

Gopher isn't an auto-fulfillment service. Every request is accepted by a real neighbor who chooses to take it, based on whether the offer feels fair to them. Other platforms can back their workers into jobs where they actually lose money — we're committed to never letting that happen. The work gets done by mutual agreement, and that's what keeps it fair for everyone.

Offers at this level can be accepted, and sometimes are — but more often they aren't. You're welcome to send it as-is, or adjust it to help it get picked up sooner.

Built for business

This is what hiring looks like when it stops being painful.

You just walked through it. Now here's why it works — for the solo founder hiring one extra set of hands, the small business spinning up a Saturday crew, and the enterprise putting twenty Gophers on the floor before lunch.

Step 1 · The signal goes out

Submit, and the whole room hears you.

Whether you need 1 worker for a week or 5 workers for 5 hours, the moment you submit a request, every qualified Gopher in range is notified. No phone tag, no waiting room — just a fleet of real workers deciding whether to raise their hand.

Step 2 · You're in the driver's seat

Hire. Consider. Deny.

Three buttons, one job: put control back where it belongs. Every interested worker is a real choice you make — not an algorithm assigning a stranger or subscription worker. Hire the ones you like. Hold the maybes. Pass on the rest. No awkward conversations required. Oh yeah — want it fully hands-off? Request a contractor to handle it all too.

Hire Consider Deny
Step 3 · Define what 'qualified' means

Credentials or muscle. Your call.

Some jobs need a 30-year licensed electrician. Some jobs need 3 strong people for a Saturday morning project. Filter by tier, certification, rating, or just open the request to everyone within reach. Not every need is the same — so we never pretend it is. But one thing is the same with every request… the process is easy!

After the job · build your bench

Find a great one? Keep them.

The Gopher who showed up on time, did the work right, and made the day easier? Save them. They become part of your MY Gophers portal — your private on-demand team that gets first dibs the next time you post a request. The longer you use Connect, the better Connect gets at being exactly yours.

It's a race to the top

Where the BEST workers WIN.

Most lead-generation platforms profit whether workers get hired or not. They charge workers for leads, creating a race to the bottom where the lowest bid often wins. Gopher Connect flips that model completely. Workers never pay for access to jobs, and success is earned through reliability, professionalism, and 5-star customer experiences. The result is a race to the top, where the best workers earn the best opportunities.

Built to scale with you
Solo founders → Small business → Mid-market → Enterprise
